comment: The release charters of the installed-app test (docs/release-qa.md). Each row of webqa/results.md names one of these ids.

charters.title: First launch
charters.text: Open DCTerminalv2 from /Applications for the first time. The window opens with the start screen and no error.

charters.title: Start screen
charters.text: The start screen shows New run, the role tiles and the recent folders; the scratch repo is offered.

charters.title: Settings round-trip
charters.text: Open Settings from the status bar gear: it takes focus, Escape closes it; change the font size, save, reopen and see the new value.

charters.title: Plain terminal tab
charters.text: Open a plain tab in the scratch repo, type a command and see its output; close the tab.

charters.title: Role tab
charters.text: Start the Onboard role tile in the scratch repo: its tab opens with Claude and the role prompt.

charters.title: Tiny Eagle-Eye run
charters.text: Start Eagle-Eye on the scratch repo with a one-line request; the run tab opens and the plan stage starts.

charters.title: Run panel
charters.text: The run panel beside the terminal shows the stepper and the stage of the run.

charters.title: Trace
charters.text: Open the Trace of the run: the sessions and events list; close it with Escape.

charters.title: Receipt
charters.text: Turn Receipts on for the scratch repo in Worktree setup and see the setting saved.

charters.title: Escape closes every Page and Dialog
charters.text: Open each Page (Run dashboard, Analytics, Trace search, Compare) and each Dialog (Runs, Settings, the palette) and press Escape: each closes at once.
